exclusions.detail: AGPL-3.0-or-later, or a commercial licence from Artifex. Neither fits a site whose source is not offered under the AGPL.
Generates new documents. It cannot open an existing PDF, so it cannot place a signature on the user's file.
A node-pre-gyp native addon; it installs a platform binary and has no browser entry point.
Published as "SEE LICENSE IN" a commercial subscription agreement, and needs a licence key at runtime.
No licence field in the manifest; Apryse licenses the product commercially and keys it per deployment.
Last published in 2016. An unmaintained parser is the wrong place to open files a user cannot re-check.
